label: A society holds a power given in…: HoldsPower c p: the society c holds the power p as given in…
term: a society holds a power given in Jesus' commission (Holding.HoldsPower)
definition: `HoldsPower c p`: the society c holds the power p (a constructor of Commissions.Power) as given in Jesus' commission, so that its exercise within c is the exercise of that power. Example: a community whose leaders bind and loose in Jesus' name. Counterexample: an individual charismatic with no society. That giving a governing power constitutes a founded society holding it is an open premise (STMT-GOVERNING-GIFT-CONSTITUTES-FOUNDED-SOCIETY).
